writer.name: 格雷瓜尔·格雷斯林 Grégoire Graesslin

director.name: 格雷瓜尔·格雷斯林 Grégoire Graesslin

introduction: 4 Parisian students arrive on a small Brittany island, where the program includes detox, yoga and studying. All goes well until they discover bales of cocaine. Initially reluctant, the students finally give in to temptation… At the same time, Karim and his gang arrive to pick up the merchandise. As a storm approaches, they are all unaware of the nightmare that awaits them…
